property_summary: For any proposed address supplied by the fuzzer, when the admin (the deployer, address(this)) calls setOwner, the contract's owner must become exactly that proposed address; the mutant instead sets owner to msg.sender (the admin), violating this whenever the proposed address differs from the admin.
change_summary: Replace 'owner = _owner;' with 'owner = msg.sender;' so the owner is set to the caller instead of the argument.
